title: Can we Debias Social Stereotypes in AI-Generated Images? Examining Text-to-Image Outputs and User Perceptions

bias_targets.methodology: Automated evaluation using a theory-driven rubric and GPT-4o to compute a Social Stereotype Index (SSI) that assesses the presence of stereotypical gender roles and presentations in text-to-image outputs for geocultural, occupational, and adjectival queries.
Automated evaluation using a rubric and GPT-4o to compute an SSI based on the presence of stereotypical racial, ethnic, and skin tone representations across text-to-image outputs.

Rubric-based audit using GPT-4o to detect geocultural stereotypes, evaluating visual markers such as stereotypical clothing, habits, food, and lifestyle associated with specific nationalities or regions.
Evaluation using a theory-driven rubric and GPT-4o to detect stereotypical age associations in generated images corresponding to different cultural groups, occupations, and descriptive adjectives.
Assessed via an automated rubric that checks for visual indicators of socioeconomic status, background environments, and implied power dynamics in the generated text-to-image outputs.
